visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with long dark hair, wearing a grey denim button-up shirt, sits behind a table filled with various buffet dishes including salmon, tempura, and shrimp. The setting is a dimly lit, upscale restaurant with wooden paneling and warm ambient lighting. (2) The man excitedly gestures with his hands while looking directly at the camera, introducing a 'secret' way to eat at the buffet. Large white and blue text overlays appear on the center of the screen. (3) Close-up shot focusing on a white bowl where a spoon extracts bright orange fish roe from a seaweed hand roll. The roe is mixed with creamy orange Thousand Island dressing and translucent orange salmon slices in a small white ceramic dish. (4) The mixture is then scooped back into the seaweed cone. The lighting is bright and focused on the food, highlighting the textures of the ingredients. (5) A close-up view of two baked oysters topped with melted cheese and red sauce. Chopsticks place a piece of red, fermented kimchi onto the top of the oyster. The background shows other plates and the restaurant's warm wooden interior. (6) The man then eats the oyster in one bite, looking impressed and nodding. Pink variety text with a glowing border appears saying 'Super Delicious.' (7) The camera focuses on a long, thin slice of raw, marbled beef on a white plate. Chopsticks place a square piece of pale yellow apple on one end, and the beef is carefully rolled around the fruit. (8) A macro shot shows the beef roll being dipped into a brown sauce. The man then puts the whole roll in his mouth, closing his eyes to savor the flavor. (9) A series of shots showing a dessert being prepared in a white bowl. First, white rosemary mousse is scooped out of a glass, then clear amber apple jelly is chopped into pieces and poured into the bowl. (10) A yellowish liquid from a glass is added, and everything is stirred together with a spoon. The man eats a spoonful of this mixture, looking wide-eyed and theatrical, while a black-and-white crow graphic appears next to him. (11) The final sequence shows a montage of various buffet items including rows of shrimp and sushi platters. The man smiles and points towards the viewer as stylized text appears on screen asking for their creative eating methods.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 饗食天堂Buffet 隱藏吃法大公開. (2) [Subtitle]: 魚卵手捲取出魚卵（料多不要飯）. (3) [Subtitle]: 魚卵+千島醬+鮭魚 混合均勻放回手捲. (4) [Variety]: 超級好吃. (5) [Subtitle]: 焗烤生蠔+泡菜. (6) [Subtitle]: 簡單搭配 意想不到的美味. [Subtitle]: 吃不慣生蠔苦味的話 泡菜會把蓋掉. [Subtitle]: 生蠔會跳出來. (7) [Subtitle]: 和風生牛肉+蘋果. (8) [Subtitle]: 入口和風醬酸味 和蘋果甜結合在一起. (9) [Subtitle]: 如果想要吃回本 一定要吃這道. [Subtitle]: 可以吃更多牛肉. (10) [Subtitle]: 迷迭香蘋果凍取出迷迭香. (11) [Subtitle]: 果凍切碎倒入碗中. (12) [Subtitle]: 加入柳橙雞尾酒. (13) [Subtitle]: 放入迷迭香慕斯. (14) [Subtitle]: 和慕斯一起吃進去. (15) [Subtitle]: 雞尾酒的酸 和蘋果凍的甜味 在嘴裡合而為一. (16) [Subtitle]: 這是天堂的味道嗎. (17) [Slogan]: 饗食天堂創意吃法 底下留言告訴我.
